summary.text: Marcus Palumbo is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 47, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he is running against incumbent Doug Dubitsky (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is running on lowering costs, which he described as fighting a "Scam Economy."

paragraphs.text: Palumbo earned a bachelor's degree from Clark University in 2026, according to Ballotpedia.

In the Ballotpedia survey, Palumbo listed his key messages as ending what he called the Eversource monopoly by letting towns pursue public municipal electric power, lowering property taxes through more state support for towns, and stopping AI data centers in Eastern Connecticut.
Ballotpedia lists the Connecticut AFL-CIO among his endorsements.
